_comment: subnt renderer (change: subnt-renderer): composes the public subnt.dev edition from stores already on disk, read-only, and publishes it into a second checkout when the content hash changes. No provider call, no model call, no chain call. Atlas writes subnt; subnt is never read back. Rollback: enabled false stops compose and publish and touches nothing else; publish false composes and writes nothing. Rename deployed 2026-09-22 with prior publish state preserved. Publishing originally enabled 2026-09-11. Credential: a write-scoped deploy key for vanlabs-dev/subnt at ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_subnt; the checkout at checkout_dir must use the SSH remote.
